device: ONE soft organic reach-ribbon (the walking-reach isochrone) on the illustrated map: places INSIDE light warm + named, the few just OUTSIDE stay faint with '+N хв'. A 5/10-min toggle grows/shrinks the ribbon. The message = coverage (what fits inside N minutes), not lines/counter/scale.
data_pipeline: SAME real-OSM bake as the smarts map; the ribbon is a real isochrone from the walking-reach routing, POI coords + minutes from the bake. Drawn light + simplified.

geometry_honesty.inside_test: point-in-polygon of each POI against the live ribbon path (sampled outline) -> the lit set is geometrically honest to the drawn shape
geometry_honesty.pin_positioning: DOM nodes via svg.getScreenCTM() (0px), preserveAspectRatio slice (round)
geometry_honesty.monotonic: POI coords placed so distance-from-home RISES with data-min (park 4хв closest -> gym 15хв farthest) so the map never contradicts the minutes
geometry_honesty.ribbon_shape: LOBED irregular blobs (radial variation ~0.09, NOT a perfect oval ~0.02) that bulge along roads + pinch at the river -> reads as an authored isochrone, not a sticker

reveal: ribbon outline strokes in (stroke-dashoffset) -> warm fill floods (fill-opacity) -> inside places light staggered nearest-first; reach toggle re-runs it

live_state.plus_convention: inside label = 'N хв', outside = '+N хв' -- driven from the LIVE inside/outside state (not hardcoded), on both the map label and the legend row

responsive: <940px: map FIRST (order -1, 56vh) so the coverage shape is in-fold, then the column + legend; grid min-height auto (no second-scroll-to-see-the-shape)
fit_mode: preserveAspectRatio 'slice' (fill) on desktop; component.js swaps to 'meet' (letterbox, nothing cropped) at <=940px so the south lobe + the farthest proof-pins (gym/post) never crop off the narrower stage (the '+N хв outside' contrast is half the argument, so no proof-pin may vanish). CTM is isotropic in both, so dots + the home stay round either way.

a11y.legend: role=list, rows role=listitem + aria-label 'Назва, N хвилин пішки'
a11y.contrast: outside labels + active toggle + all small text >= WCAG AA on cream

edge_labels: .rr-poi--lr / --rl anchor the label inward so edge POIs never clip the stage
